notes: Costco queue farming is a new optional module: paste a product or waiting-room URL and farm unique Queue-it sessions.
Passed Costco tasks open a headed browser on that same proxy so operators can finish checkout.
Costco, Pokémon Center, and Walmart use one Start All control that becomes Stop Tasks while anything is running.
Costco access is licensed like Pokémon Center and Walmart, so it can be enabled globally or per account.
